question: How is the Lord father mother and support of the world?
premises: I am father mother supporter and grandfather
I am the knowable purifier and om
I am rig sama and yajur
inference: the Lord is the whole source and substance of world and Veda
plain_english: I am father, mother, supporter, and grandfather of this world; I am the knowable, purifier, om, rig, sama, and yajur.
